outcome: abnormal 2-hour oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) result
cohort: The study included patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who delivered >20 weeks' gestation and completed both a postpartum FBG prior to discharge and a 2-hour 75-g OGTT within 1 year of delivery.
finding: A postpartum FBG of 88 mg/dL was identified as the optimal cut-off, demonstrating a negative predictive value of 92.4% for ruling out an abnormal 2-hour OGTT.
